result.quote: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”
result.reason: The key captures mutual destruction by fire, but it is materially incomplete and imprecise: the curse specifically names the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, not simply Shechem, and describes fire coming from each side to consume the other.
